       CASE WHEN open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= '2024-07-29' THEN 'pre-P4-2024'

            ELSE 'opened-in-P4-2024' END as open_status_p4_2024,
       CASE WHEN close_date IS NULL OR close_date >= '2025-08-24' THEN 'open-in-P4-2025'

            ELSE 'closed-in-P4-2025' END as close_status_p4_2025
FROM dim_store
WHERE is_current = TRUE

WITH lfl_stores AS (
  -- Stores that existed and were open during both P4 periods
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store
  WHERE (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= '2024-07-29')
    AND (close_date IS NULL OR close_date >= '2025-08-24')
    AND store_id NOT IN (900, 999)  -- Exclude web and training stores
),
sales_p4_2024 AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'  -- Store channel only
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id
),
sales_p4_2025 AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    s.store_id,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'  -- Store channel only
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id
)
SELECT 
  COALESCE(p24.store_id, p25.store_id) as store_id,
  COALESCE(p24.fiscal_year, 'FY2024/25') as fy_2024,
  COALESCE(p24.net_sales, 0) as sales_2024,
  COALESCE(p25.fiscal_year, 'FY2025/26') as fy_2025,
  COALESCE(p25.net_sales, 0) as sales_2025,
  COALESCE(p25.net_sales, 0) - COALESCE(p24.net_sales, 0) as sales_change,
  ROUND(((COALESCE(p25.net_sales, 0) - COALESCE(p24.net_sales, 0)) / NULLIF(COALESCE(p24.net_sales, 0), 0)) * 100, 1) as pct_change
FROM sales_p4_2024 p24
FULL OUTER JOIN sales_p4_2025 p25 ON p24.store_id = p25.store_id
ORDER BY store_id

WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store
  WHERE (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= '2024-07-29')
    AND (close_date IS NULL OR close_date >= '2025-08-24')
    AND store_id NOT IN (900, 999)
),
sales_p4_2024 AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
    SUM(f.quantity) as total_units
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
),
sales_p4_2025 AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as total_net_sales,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
    SUM(f.quantity) as total_units
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
)
SELECT 
  p24.total_net_sales as sales_fy2024_25_p4,
  p25.total_net_sales as sales_fy2025_26_p4,
  p25.total_net_sales - p24.total_net_sales as sales_change_eur,
  ROUND(((p25.total_net_sales - p24.total_net_sales) / p24.total_net_sales) * 100, 1) as lfl_change_pct,
  p24.receipt_count as receipts_fy2024_25,
  p25.receipt_count as receipts_fy2025_26,
  p24.total_units as units_fy2024_25,
  p25.total_units as units_fy2025_26
FROM sales_p4_2024 p24, sales_p4_2025 p25

WITH lfl_stores AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store
  WHERE (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= '2024-07-29')
    AND (close_date IS NULL OR close_date >= '2025-08-24')
    AND store_id NOT IN (900, 999)
),
sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    s.region,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' OR d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.region
)
SELECT 
  region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_fy2024_25,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_fy2025_26,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) - 
  SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) as sales_change,
  ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) - 
          SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END)) / 
         NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 1) as lfl_change_pct
FROM sales_data
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY region

WITH lfl_stores AS (
  -- Like-for-like stores: those operating in both P4 periods
  SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store
  WHERE (open_date IS NULL OR open_date <= '2024-07-29')
    AND (close_date IS NULL OR close_date >= '2025-08-24')
    AND store_id NOT IN (900, 999)
),
p4_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    SUM(f.net_amount) as store_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' OR d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26')
    AND d.fiscal_period = 4
    AND f.channel_code = 'ST'
    AND s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM lfl_stores)
  GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, s.store_name
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  SUM(store_sales) as total_net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) as store_count,
  ROUND(SUM(store_sales) / COUNT(DISTINCT store_id), 2) as avg_store_sales
FROM p4_sales
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year
